status: OPEN. This is an investigation record, not a cause. It exists so the next attempt does not re-derive two candidates already refuted at source.
rows: 19000093/51 -- segment() returns None, voiding >85% of branch mass
19000093/53 -- segments, but files Megahorn's damage in the end-of-turn slice, where the EXACT bucket rejects a legal roll difference (55 vs 53)
the_mechanism_that_IS_established: segment() (events.rs:416+) does not read move markers. It rebuilds each side's Choice with build_choice, regenerates the first mover's branches with generate_instructions_from_move, keeps those whose instruction_list is an EXACT PREFIX of the pair-generated `full`, then regenerates the second mover on top of each candidate and requires a phase-2 branch that is also a prefix of `full`. With no eot it additionally requires list.len() == full.len(). If no (p1, p2) pair reproduces `full` exactly, it returns None and events.rs:766-779 returns the branch with ZERO components -- which the differential then counts as strict:lossy_render and skips the boundary.

candidate_1_REFUTED.hypothesis: the missing first-mover DecrementPP breaks the split (reports/c96 v1 named this).
candidate_1_REFUTED.refutation: segment() reads no markers at all. It prefix-matches a regeneration, so a marker absent from the engine's list is equally absent from the regeneration. Additionally the emission rule is deliberate: generate_instructions.rs:2800-2803 decrements PP only when the move is under 10 PP, and SetLastUsedMove is gated on state.use_last_used_move at :2849.
candidate_1_REFUTED.counter_evidence_from_the_rows_themselve: 19000093/51 HAS the DecrementPP and is the row that fails segmentation; 19000093/53 LACKS it and segments fine. The correlation runs backwards.

candidate_2_REFUTED.hypothesis: first_move diverges between the pair generation and the regeneration. The 16-roll gate at generate_instructions.rs:2911-2915 is `branch_on_damage && choice.first_move && pending_hp_reading_move(defender_choice)`, so if the regenerated first mover carried first_move = false its branch structure would differ from the pair generation's and no prefix could match.
candidate_2_REFUTED.refutation: checked at source and it is handled correctly. Choice::default() sets first_move: true (choices.rs:20737), build_choice's Move arm clones the move's stored Choice which carries the same default, and segment() explicitly sets second_choice.first_move = false before phase 2. The first mover is first_move = true and the second is false, which is what the pair generation does.
candidate_2_REFUTED.note: 14 sites in gen3/generate_instructions.rs read first_move; segment() gets the flag right for all of them.

where_to_look_next: the established mechanism says the failure is that the PAIR-generated list is not reproducible by composing the two per-move generations. Candidates not yet checked: (a) branch ORDER or probability-driven ordering differing between pair and per-side generation, so a valid decomposition exists but is not a prefix in the order emitted; (b) state mutation -- segment() passes the same `state` to both phases and generate_instructions_from_move takes &mut State, so phase 2 may regenerate against a state already advanced by phase 1's generation rather than by phase 1's INSTRUCTIONS; (c) the `!eot && list.len() != full.len()` exactness requirement rejecting an otherwise-valid split. (b) is the strongest prior and is cheap to test by instrumenting segment() to log which of the three exit conditions each candidate hits.
why_this_matters_beyond_two_rows: segmentation_failed does not merely fail to attribute -- it SKIPS the boundary, removing it from the KPI denominator entirely. PR #1037 was closed for a change that pushed 39 boundaries into that bucket, 37 of which had previously MATCHED. Any renderer change can buy a lower divergence count by rendering less, so the size of this bucket is a standing measurement hazard, recorded in PR #1038.
honesty_note: I formed candidate 2 and was about to write it up as the cause. Checking choices.rs:20737 first is the only reason it is filed as refuted rather than shipped as a finding.
